ideas.title: The $11M Minnesota Medicaid Fraud Case: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the suspect who fled before trial and the implications for Medicaid fraud prevention in Minnesota.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the suspect's connections to other entities or individuals involved in similar schemes.
questions: Who was involved in the scheme?
How did the suspect manage to flee?
What are the implications for Medicaid in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover more about the suspect's network and how they managed to carry out such a large-scale fraud.

ideas.title: The Impact of Government Fraud on Public Perception
ideas.description: Explore how government fraud affects public perception of institutions and the rising cost of living.
ideas.angle: Analyze the poll results and connect them to recent cases of government fraud.
questions: How does government fraud affect public trust?
What are the economic implications of government fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could provide insight into how government fraud impacts public perception and economic stability.
